one_line: AI sees massive funding, new model launches, embodied research breakthroughs, and widening industry adoption.

themes.title: DeepSeek secures $15 billion funding
themes.text: DeepSeek, a Chinese AI startup, raised roughly 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) from investors including CATL and Tencent, two days after U.S. agencies were ordered to remove its technology.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions

themes.title: Advances in embodied AI evaluation
themes.text: Researchers benchmarked six frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 robot manipulation suite, introduced the PAPAV framework for multimodal agents, and created the Environment Duels benchmark to study LLM co‑evolution in dynamic environments.

stories.headline: Frontier AI models evaluated on LIBERO-10 robot tasks, GPT‑6 Astra tops at 44% success
Paper proposes PAPAV framework to unify multimodal agents and robots
Environment Duels benchmark studies LLM co‑evolution through author‑solver interactions

themes.title: Major AI model releases announced
themes.text: Mistral AI previewed the 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4 multimodal model and launched the Voxtral 3 voice SDK; Anthropic released Claude Duet, and OpenAI announced GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models on Google Cloud for select enterprise customers.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent in research preview
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud

themes.title: AI services expand across commerce and government
themes.text: Walmart introduced an Agent Gateway for shopper AI agents, Karta AI raised a $3 million seed round for multilingual banking call automation, and NVIDIA’s open‑weight models were adopted in European public‑sector projects, weather forecasting, and retail inference pipelines.

stories.headline: Walmart to let AI agents shop for customers via new Agent Gateway
Karta AI raises $3 million seed round to automate complex inbound banking calls
NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models
